import json,re,time,chess,random,signal
R=json.load(open("re.json"))
random.seed(0)
b=chess.Board()
for ply in range(60):
    if b.turn==chess.WHITE:
        fen=b.fen(); print(fen, flush=True)
        for i,(p,r) in enumerate(R):
            t=time.time(); fen=re.sub(p,r,fen); d=time.time()-t
            if d>0.05: print(i,d,p[:150],len(fen), flush=True)
    b.push(random.choice(list(b.legal_moves)))
EOF
